overview: TradeNest Naturals supplies Alfalfa Powder in bulk for B2B buyers who need a consistent, fine botanical ingredient from India. The product is dehydrated and milled to an 80-100 mesh profile, with moisture below 7% and a shelf life of 24 months. It is suitable for manufacturers, brands, and distributors looking for a reliable ingredient source with export-ready support.

Our process follows six clear stages: sourcing, cleaning and sorting, controlled drying, grinding and sieving, quality inspection, and packing and dispatch. We support OEM and private label requirements, custom mesh on request, and packaging options for bulk and small-format needs. Samples and export documentation support are available on request.
